title: Unlock your calls
body: Use the passkey you created for AskCalls.
bodyNoPasskey: Use your passphrase or your recovery code.
lost: Without a passkey or recovery code, calls can't be recovered. <link>Options</link>

rc.title: Enter your recovery code
rc.wrong: Wrong code. Check each group and try again.

passkeyFailed: Couldn't unlock with this passkey. Try again or use your recovery code.
offline: You're offline. Unlocking needs a connection to fetch your keys.

signOutConfirm.title: Sign out of AskCalls?
signOutConfirm.body: Signing out also removes this device's saved keys. You'll need your passkey or recovery code to unlock again.

linkBrowser: Link this browser from another device

join.title: Link this browser
join.body: On a device that's already unlocked, open Settings → Security → Link a device. Scan its QR code with this device, or paste the code here.
join.invalid: This code isn't readable. Copy it again.
join.otherAccount: This code is for a different account. Sign in with that account first.
join.failed: Couldn't connect with this code. Create a new one and try again.
join.compareBody: Check that your other device shows the same 6 digits, then confirm there.
join.expired: This code expired. Create a new one on your other device.
join.protectBody: This browser is linked. Create a passkey so you can unlock here next time.
join.passkeyCancelled: Passkey wasn't created. Try again or use a passphrase.
join.noPrf: This browser can't unlock AskCalls with a passkey. Set a passphrase instead.
join.passwordManager: Your password manager can't unlock AskCalls with a passkey. Try again and save the passkey in this browser or on a security key.
join.hasPassphrase: This browser can't unlock AskCalls with a passkey. Use your passphrase to unlock here.
